question: What attainment follows from performing the practice one hundred and eight times?
premises: The practice is performed one hundred and eight times.
Completion of this count produces a specific mastery.
Mastery over all siddhis is the stated result.
inference: Performing the practice one hundred and eight times makes one lord of all siddhis.
plain_english: Having done it one hundred and eight times, one may become the lord of all powers.
